svg.title: Two chessboards side by side. Left, a natural game position: masters recall about 93% of the pieces, novices about 33%. Right, the same pieces scattered in an impossible way: masters and novices both recall only 3 to 4 pieces. The edge vanishes when the patterns vanish
svg.text: bar = share of the position rebuilt from memory after a few seconds' look
The edge vanishes when the patterns vanish.
